who: A priest of Saradomin and a descendant of one of the Seven Priestly Warriors, keeping Paterdomus and the holy Salve beneath it. Once the player frees him from the Zamorakians he stays in the mausoleum under the temple, guarding the pass into Morytania, worrying about his druid friend Filliman, and later teaching young Ivan of the Myreque. He wants Misthalin safe behind the Salve and the faith kept pure.
notices: signs of faith, or the lack of it, in a passer-by: a holy symbol, a blessing, something of the faith about them
swamp mud and the look of someone just back from Mort Myre

address: "adventurer" to a stranger, "my friend" or "friend" once he knows you: "How goes it, adventurer?"
grammar: full, courteous sentences with a clause or two
blessings and Saradomin's name ('Saradomin bless him!', 'Saradomin be with you')
polite but firm refusals on matters of faith ('Please, do not challenge me on matters of faith.')
history told as 'It is said that...'
rhythm: Measured and kindly, a little formal, with a priest's habit of explaining; sharpens quickly into offence if his faith is questioned.
canon: "Saradomin bless him! He is a good man." (Transcript:Nature Spirit)
"Please, do not challenge me on matters of faith." (Transcript:In Aid of the Myreque)
"Trust in Saradomin, friend." (Transcript:Drezel, after Sins of the Father)
"Good luck out there. Stay safe." (Transcript:Priest in Peril)
neverSay: that Ivandis Seergaze is buried anywhere but Paterdomus: he denies it even after the player knows better
that Ivan is the last descendant of Ivandis: he keeps that to himself
